description: Diagnostic flowchart for out-of-specification force readings at the insert pressing station.

box_1.text: Do part and insert meet the required specifications?

box_2.text: Check input material and quality specifications, note the thickness of the insert.

box_3.text: Remove the non conforming material and reload with parts and inserts that meet the required dimensional specifications.

box_4.text: Is placing part on insert correct?

box_5.text: Verify that the part is mounted straight on the insert and is not tilted.

box_7.text: Is the pressing part process functioning?

box_8.text: Verify that the part is pressed at the correct stable speed straight into the insert, with no gap remaining.

box_10.text: Is the control for part lying flat (vacuum) functioning?

box_11.text: Verify that the vacuum system correctly pulls and seats the part against the fixture.

box_13.text: Is there a cable break on the force sensor?

box_14.text: Move the cable and check whether the force reading on the operator control interface remains stable.

box_15.text: Replace the force sensor cable that shows the break or intermittent signal reading.

box_16.text: Is the force sensor correctly calibrated?

box_17.text: Using a separate force sensor meter, move the pressing heads downward and verify that the force reading on the operator control interface matches the meter reading.

box_18.text: Force sensor calibration procedure at pressing station

box_19.text: Confirm that the measured force values are within the control limits.
